name: Daruma Woman
source:
A wheelchair-bound, limbless mass murderer who has weapons stowed within her prosthetic legs. Her modified wheelchair tops out at 50 KPH, allowing her to hunt her prey to the ends of the earth.

She's become something of an urban legend in Tokyo

[From Shiravuna, via [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1433]MangaGamer[/url]]
